projects.title: RentSure
projects.description: A rental-profile and rent-score platform helping tenants present their rental history and property owners review applications in Nigeria.
projects.projectDetails: Developed by EazziMe Technologies Inc., RentSure brings tenants, landlords, and property agents into a shared rental-information platform. Tenants organize their profile and supporting records, while property teams review rental history and rent-score information to support their assessment.
features: Tenant profiles with identity and supporting rental information
Rent-score summaries alongside rental history and profile indicators
Views for landlords and agents to review applicant information
Rental records, reminders, and proof of rent in one place

projects.title: ChaufX
projects.description: A personal-driver platform connecting customers with professional drivers for journeys in their own vehicles.
projects.projectDetails: Developed by EazziMe Technologies Inc., ChaufX brings customer booking, driver onboarding, and trip management into a connected platform. Customers arrange a driver for their own vehicle, while dedicated customer and driver apps support each side of the journey.
features: Trip booking with pickup, destination, and preferred time
Driver applications with document uploads and review status
Customer and driver apps for managing and accepting trips
Driver earnings tracking and role-based account access

projects.title: EazziHotech
projects.description: A hospitality operations platform bringing bookings, guest records, and payment tracking together for hotels, shortlets, and serviced apartments.
projects.projectDetails: Developed by EazziMe Technologies Inc., EazziHotech helps hospitality teams manage the guest journey from booking through check-out. Operators can organize multiple properties and units in one workspace, with separate tenant data and role-based access for administrators, managers, and staff.
features: Guest profiles, identity records, and stay history
Payment, outstanding balance, damage, and settlement tracking
Multi-property management with role-based staff access
Guest email notifications for key stages of a stay

projects.title: EazziBulkBuy.ca
projects.description: A bulk food and produce platform that helps customers shop community sales, choose quantities, and place orders online.
projects.projectDetails: Built by EazziMe Technologies Inc., EazziBulkBuy connects customers with bulk food and produce sales. The platform brings active sales events, product selection, and online ordering together in one place for communities in Manitoba.
features: Active bulk sales with product details and quantity selection
Normal sales and discounted bundle offers
Checkout options for Interac e-Transfer and card payments
Order confirmation and pickup instructions by email

guidance: MVP enquiries are handled through product design and custom software development. Scope must be confirmed by the team.
